Sam K: Ops note: set UTM params: utm_source=skydeck, utm_medium=marketplace, utm_campaign=sd_webinar_july. Also variant param for copy AB.

AutoDeployBot: Reminder: Landing page auto-publish scheduled at 1932107200.
